title: Blanket & Pages Nook

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min while settling in with a book.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist linens lightly and away from faces.

why_it_works: Sweet citrus brightens the page while soft, resinous and woody notes create a cozy, grounded reading atmosphere.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
